native_interface_facts.RGB: 1x3xHxW RGB float32 [0,1]; Stage I uses [-1,1]; RGB8 output clamps then truncates, not rounds.
native_interface_facts.resize: Official CLI caps long side at1024 without upsampling, floors each dimension to multiple16, PIL LANCZOS; focal pixel coordinates refer to that resized grid. Existing1024x576 is unchanged.
native_interface_facts.native_depth: DA-V2 relative inverse depth; D=1-minmax(disparity) per image, in [0,1], 1=far. Not metric depth. Scene.depth shape1xHxW; renderer receives1x1xHxW.
native_interface_facts.depth_estimator_preprocess: Short side input_size1024, aspect preserved, multiple14 lower_bound; GPU bicubic align_corners=False then ImageNet normalization; predicted disparity bilinear align_corners=True to image grid; FP16 autocast.
native_interface_facts.native_constant_disparity: Actual disparity_to_depth output is all ones for a constant map. Its docstring says zeros; CPU check records actual return value. Benchmark adapter should reject invalid geometry instead of silently relying on this fallback.
native_interface_facts.focus: Scene.focal_depth_at rounds/clamps x,y then samples own D; render accepts focal-depth scalar directly.
native_interface_facts.condition_maps: Signed Ms=D-Df; front_mask=max_pool2d((Ms<1e-3),5,stride1,padding2); concat Ms/front_mask/constant strength; defocus attention sees abs(Ms). Preserve source threshold/dilation; prose <=0 is an approximation.
native_interface_facts.strength: Paper/native documented interval[0,1], CLI default0.5; no renderer input clamp. Public Demo slider[0,1.5] labels>1 as extrapolated. Not equal to project K4/8/16/32.
native_interface_facts.restoration_defaults: detail_weight1.25, refiner enabled; Stage I core FP16, two UNet predictions when omega!=1; refiner BF16. VAE latent uses posterior mode, not posterior sample.
native_interface_facts.render_precision: Renderer weights loaded FP32, default BF16 autocast, output cast FP32; channels_last=False and merge_vae_lora=False. Author cost script changes refiner toFP16 and channels_last=True; do not silently substitute cost-script settings for default-quality configuration.
native_interface_facts.restore_quantization: prepare(deblur=True) clamps and quantizes restored RGB to8 bits before estimating depth/rendering. prepare(deblur=False) uses supplied image without restoration or extra restore quantization.
native_interface_facts.already_sharp_cli_loading: scripts/refocus.py --already-sharp skips restoration compute but still calls from_pretrained() with deblurring=True and loads Stage I/refiner. It is not a minimal renderer/depth-only loader.
native_interface_facts.true_native_no_deblur: Refocuser.from_pretrained(deblurring=False), then prepare(image,deblur=False); both flags needed because prepare defaults to deblur=True. Still loads DA-V2 and renderer.
native_interface_facts.external_geometry_entry: Candidate only: instantiate Refocuser(None,None,load_renderer(...)) and construct Scene(image,D); call render(scene,strength,F). Bypasses estimate/prepare, leaves learned renderer and its condition construction unchanged.
native_interface_facts.import_dependency_caveat: flashrefocus.__init__ eagerly imports pipeline->Deblurrer->OneStepDiffusion(PiSASR_eval). Even deblurring=False / external-geometry use currently require PiSA-SR and its inference dependencies to import, though not its checkpoints for model construction.
native_interface_facts.cache_temporal: Scene caches image/depth for edits of one photograph. It provides no temporal feature model, overlap handling or native temporal consistency guarantee. Do not reuse prior frame Scene for a different video frame or add temporal smoothing without a separately approved adapter.
native_interface_facts.method_name: Paper explicitly distinguishes AnyBokeh from the video Any-to-Bokeh used in this project.

adapter_proposal.recommended_variant: External shared geometry/focus, renderer-only, already-sharp RGB. Keep full-native restoration+own-depth as a separate reproduction variant; never mix variant parameters/timing/results.

difference_table.official: Single photo; default restore then quantize
difference_table.benchmark_proposal: Synthetic already-sharp RGB, DAVIS existing RGB; no Stage I by default; same1024x576/25frames. Retain existing RGB resize rules, not extra LANCZOS on already fixed inputs. No GT alpha/mask enters generator.
difference_table.pending: Validate official no-deblur path first. DAVIS originals may contain optical blur; skipping restoration is an explicit input/variant limitation, not proof they are all sharp.

difference_table.benchmark_proposal: Use existing disparity d in frozen shared [0,1] coordinate, D=1-d (no per-frame renormalization), aligned to RGB with the frozen geometry resize. Preserve supplied values and source rights.
difference_table.pending: Requires approval; differs from native own-depth preprocessing, while preserving actual renderer functions.

difference_table.official: Own D at clicked pixel, rounded/clamped
difference_table.benchmark_proposal: F=1-f from SAME supplied disparity coordinate. Keep frozen per-frame f; do not resample a different pixel/mask or silently clamp. Ms=-(d-f); abs(Ms)=abs(d-f).
difference_table.pending: Validate finite/range and record any out-of-range f; stop for a policy decision instead of clamping or changing target.

difference_table.official: Separate native scalar s in[0,1], default0.5
difference_table.benchmark_proposal: One global, deterministic, nondecreasing table s(K) for K4/8/16/32 from an independent control calibration; no defaultK/32.
difference_table.pending: No numerical mapping exists yet; do not use formal benchmark GT/scores or per-scene adjustment.

difference_table.official: Stage I FP16; default refiner and renderer BF16 autocast; outputFP32

For video E2E-given-inputs measure actual25frames, read/decode through CPU uint8; exclude model load, write/encode/metrics/external geometry generation. Core boundary and counted parameters match active modules.

normalization_alternative_not_selected.formula: If later choosing D=1-(d-lo)/span, F=1-(f-lo)/span, use identical lo/span for both. Then Ms=-(d-f)/span.
normalization_alternative_not_selected.limits: Not algebraically equivalent to shared geometry at unchanged strength. Native per-frame normalization changes defocus scale; strength enters several learned paths, so multiplying strength by span is not generally an exact compensation. Do not clamp F or silently switch conventions. No inverse-meter1/d transformation.

independent_calibration_proposal.inputs: Procedural RGB textures/isolated edge and impulse patches, no Synthetic/DAVIS footage, GT or annotations; correct piecewise-constant control disparity with levels0.2/0.5/0.8. Two fixed texture layouts x three focal values(0.2/0.5/0.8)=6small controls, all at1024x576.
independent_calibration_proposal.budget: 6controls x9strengths=54renderer-only outputs after official example succeeds; no training. A second deterministic texture phase reserved for checking the mapping, not refitting.
independent_calibration_proposal.measurement: Within constant-depth interiors, avoid occlusion edges. Record edge10-90% spread plus normalized impulse second-moment blur width, luminance/color residual and in-focus preservation. Measure response relative to s=0; no neural metric. Use both sides of focus and multiple abs(d-f).
independent_calibration_proposal.target: Construct CPU soft-disk reference responses for each K under documented nominal radius K*abs(d-f) at the same resolution; freeze kernel, interpolation, ROI and width estimator BEFORE running the candidate. MPIB actual layer-bin/focus-range and gamma conventions must be disclosed if used instead. This is control calibration, not formal proxy-GT matching or a claim of physical CoC equivalence.
independent_calibration_proposal.selection: One equally weighted aggregate absolute blur-width residual per candidate strength and project K across all control layouts/depths/sides; select the nondecreasing four-value mapping minimizing that predefined aggregate, ties choose smaller strength. Freeze mapping and report per-condition residuals; no per-scene or per-frame strength fitting.
independent_calibration_proposal.failure_policy: If response is nonmonotonic, saturates before a target, or near/far controls disagree materially, report mismatch and unresolved K coverage; do not silently extrapolate>1, change geometry/thresholds, or claim physical equivalence. Proposed acceptance limits and exact kernel must be confirmed before any calibration run.

timing_boundaries.full_native: RGB decode/resize/transfer -> Stage I restoration+restore quantization -> own DA-V2 -> focus/conditions -> renderer -> all25CPU uint8RGB. Model loading/output writes/encoding/metrics excluded for project E2E; stageI+depth+renderer parameter scope.
timing_boundaries.native_no_deblur: RGB decode/adapt/transfer -> own DA-V2 -> focus/conditions -> renderer -> all25CPU uint8RGB; noStageI; count DA-V2+renderer.
timing_boundaries.external_geometry_renderer_only: Read/decode already-provided RGB/d/f/K -> frozen adapter+transfer -> original renderer -> all25CPU uint8RGB; noStageI/noDA-V2; count renderer only for rendererCore and include adapter inE2E.
timing_boundaries.author_cost_caveat: Official benchmark_cost.py times restoration and depth+render separately and sums them for first_s, with intervening PNG save/read; new_focus_s uses cached Scene of same picture. It is not a measured contiguous25-frame videoE2E. Reported memory is max allocated GiB in code. No local runtime or parameter value is filled here.
